title: I Left the Wedding RSVP With the Plus-One They Already Used

parts.text: The invite had my name only. My ex, who was the groom's cousin, RSVP'd me plus a date I did not have, then showed up with her. I was twenty-eight, holding a card that smelled like lilies. I handed the original RSVP to the coordinator at the door and sat where the chart put one plate. They found a chair for the surprise in the back. I danced once. I ate bread. I did not make a toast. Plus-ones are ink. Ink was missing. The lily smell faded. I left before the bouquet. The coordinator thanked me for the card. Cards are small and sufficient.

social.video_title: The chart had one plate and the door had my original card — Part 1/1
social.description: Name-only invite, an ex with a date, bread, one dance. Would you have left before dinner?
